processing: Alpha is cut at 128 and colours snap to the outfit atlas palette. The stance head is pasted at the tracked head position so the side hair and hat overlays fit exactly, small enclosed gaps are filled and stray shoe or shirt pixels are reassigned to their material. anchors-<outfit>.json stores that head position for the side overlays.
